diagnosis.control: Both energy repairs emitted the same source digest and failed public cases. A general behavior-preservation failure, not a proved transport defect.
diagnosis.treatment: Two complete provider-bound responses contained invalid source; one response ended with finish_reason_length. Local proposed programs parse and satisfy the finite fixture oracle. Generated syntax-failure source digests differ from the host-proposed source. Truncation cannot be graded as hidden-case reasoning failure.
diagnosis.certainty: The preserved sanitized evidence classifies failure; exact raw-source/root-cause reconstruction is intentionally unavailable. No claim of complete whole-program equivalence.
diagnosis.nextSmallestMechanism: Evaluate explicit source/evidence-bound selection of an already computed refactor proposal, compiled into the existing typed edit and subjected to every existing Omega check, instead of making the model reserialize host-owned source. This is an unimplemented hypothesis, not a capability claim.

research.scope: Execution feedback and reuse of existing candidate code motivate testing conditional repair. Published paper results are not NYX evidence.

conflicts: Treating an unchanged supplied algorithm as successful model engineering conflicts with evidence attribution; corrected without changing the frozen outcomes or acceptance.
